item.title: Context Compression for DeepSeek Sparse Attention Architectures
item.dc:creator: Yingjie Tan
item.description: An exploration of KV cache compaction for agents with growing histories: query-independent reference construction, cache selection and value merging, and query-guided recovery. Single-compaction, budget, and multi-round LongBench-v2 experiments illustrate the tradeoffs between memory quality, active cache capacity, and computation.

item.title: From a Model’s Random-Number Fingerprint:A Study of LLM Reasoning Circuits
item.dc:creator: Yingjie Tan
item.description: Starting from a model fingerprint that consistently emerges in random-number generation, this post identifies a class of heads that transport candidate information. When an answer has not been effectively inferred and the model must still choose among multiple candidates, these heads produce significant causal effects. Their role generalizes across candidates, tasks, and architectures, and is consistently reproduced in various intervention experiments that interrupt normal reasoning circuits. We further use these heads’ TV values as a signal for detecting unreliable reasoning and improve the model’s reasoning performance.
